reason: Technically clean and mobile-cheap, but the three archetypes read as generic stacked-cone low-poly pines. Silhouette rhythm is too regular, canopy tiers are too concentric, authored asymmetry/depth is insufficient, and the family would make Valoria look like a prefab pack if scaled.

gate.mobile_silhouette: FAIL — readable as trees but overly generic

action: Do not integrate. Reauthor Source02 with irregular radial profiles, non-concentric canopy masses, varied tier counts, visible trunk windows and restrained branch asymmetry while retaining opaque mobile-safe materials.
